top_signals.title: Hong Kong IPO’s 177% Pop Highlights Quirk in Allocation Rules
top_signals.summary: A 177% debut surge on Wednesday by Excelland Robotics Wuxi Co. is putting a spotlight on Hong Kong’s rules for allocating shares in initial public offerings after the listing left almost 94% of the shares in institutional hands despite strong demand from retail investors.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Unicoin sues Uniswap Labs, seeks to cancel UNI registration
top_signals.summary: The complaint says Uniswap’s counsel sent three letters before Unicoin’s Sept. 28 launch and seeks declarations on its marks and domains.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
